questions.question: Which three ingredients does every optimization model specify?
options: Decision variables, an objective with a direction, and constraints
Decision variables, given data, and the constraints on them
An objective with a direction, the constraints, and the optimal plan
Decision variables and an objective with a direction, nothing more

questions.question: A planner writes down decision variables, a function $f(\boldsymbol{x})$ giving the total travel time of a plan, and the constraints. What must still be stated before the model is an optimization model?
options: Nothing, because an objective is always to be made as large as possible
Nothing, because the constraints already decide which plan is best
Whether larger or smaller values of $f(\boldsymbol{x})$ are better
The value of $f(\boldsymbol{x})$ at the best plan, as a target

questions.question: Is $\min\{x^2+3x\colon x\ge0\}$ an optimization model in the sense of a decision variable, an objective with a direction and constraints?
options: Yes; the objective and constraints need not be linear
No; an optimization model needs a linear objective
Yes, but only because its one constraint $x\ge0$ is linear
No; an optimization model needs a constraint with data

questions.question: Using $x^*=\max\{-b/2,d\}$ for $\min\{x^2+bx+c\colon x\ge d\}$, what is the optimal decision $x^*$ of $\min\{x^2-6x+8\colon x\ge1\}$?
For $\min\{x^2-4x+1\colon x\ge5\}$, what is the optimal value, the smallest objective value over the allowed $x$?
A farmer chooses hectares $w$ of wheat and $v$ of barley to make $300w+200v$ as large as possible, subject to $w+v\le50$ and $w\le30$. Which of these is a model parameter?
options: The number of hectares $w$ sown with wheat
The total profit $300w+200v$
The 50 hectares of land available
The requirement $w+v\le50$

questions.question: A model with decision variables $x$ (lorries hired) and $y$ (vans hired) has the conditions below. Which one is a domain restriction rather than a functional constraint?
options: $2x+y\le12$, a limit on drivers
$x+y\ge4$, a minimum fleet size
$x\in\{0,1,2,\dots\}$, whole lorries only
$x=2y$, a fixed lorry-van ratio

questions.question: Take $f(x)=x^2-6x+8$ and the allowed set $F=\{x\colon 1\le x\le4\}$. If $f$ is to be made as large as possible over $F$, which $x$ is optimal?
For $\min\{x^2+bx+c\colon x\ge d\}$ with optimum $x^*=\max\{-b/2,d\}$, when is the bound $d$ itself the optimal decision rather than $-b/2$?
options: When $d<-b/2$, so the lowest point lies to the right of $d$
When $c<0$, so the parabola dips below the horizontal axis
When $d>-b/2$, so the parabola's lowest point is excluded
When $b>0$, so the parabola's lowest point lies left of 0

questions.question: In $\min\{x^2+bx+c\colon x\ge d\}$, the parameters $b$, $c$ and $d$ are given numbers. Which single parameter can be changed without ever changing the optimal decision $x^*$?
options: $c$, since it shifts every objective value equally
$b$, since it only tilts the parabola slightly
$d$, since the bound is a constraint, not part of $f$
None, since any parameter change moves $x^*$

questions.question: Two analysts model the same delivery problem with the same decision variables and constraints. One minimizes total cost, the other total delivery time, and their optimal plans differ. What explains the difference?
options: One of the two analysts must have made an error in the model
A correct model has the same optimum for every choice of objective
Each objective defines what counts as better, so optima can differ
The constraints decide the optimum, so the plans must coincide

questions.question: A café makes $x$ small and $y$ large cakes, both whole numbers at least 0. Oven slots give $2x+3y\le12$, and at most 3 small cakes can be decorated, $x\le3$. Profit is $4x+5y$, to be made as large as possible. Which plan is optimal?
A firm makes $x$ units of a product at cost 5 per unit and must make at least 100 units; total cost is to be as small as possible. Which model states this?
options: $\max\{5x\colon x\ge100\}$
$\min\{5x\colon x\ge100\}$
$\min\{5x\colon x\le100\}$
$\min\{100x\colon x\ge5\}$

questions.question: Find the optimal decision of: make $(x-2)^2+(y+1)^2$ as small as possible subject to $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$ and $x+y\le1$.
For $\min\{x^2+bx+c\colon x\ge d\}$ with $d>-b/2$, why is $x^*=d$?
options: At any optimum the constraint has to hold with equality
The parabola takes the value 0 at $x=d$, its smallest value
The parabola's lowest point gives a larger value than $x=d$
The parabola rises on all of $x\ge d$, so the least allowed $x$ wins

questions.question: In $\min\{x^2+bx+c\colon x\ge d\}$, the bound $d$ is raised while $b$ and $c$ stay fixed. What happens to the optimal value?
options: It always rises, since the allowed set gets smaller
It cannot fall, and it stays equal while $d\le-b/2$
It can fall if the new bound lies far to the right
It always falls, since a larger $d$ is a larger bound

questions.question: Adapt the reasoning behind $x^*=\max\{-b/2,d\}$ to a maximization: which $x$ is optimal for $\max\{8x-x^2\colon x\le3\}$?
For $\min\{x^2+bx+c\colon x\ge1\}$ with unknown parameters $b$ and $c$, the optimal decision is reported as $x^*=1$. Using $x^*=\max\{-b/2,d\}$ with $d=1$, what can be concluded about $b$?
options: That $b=-2$ exactly, so that $-b/2$ equals the bound
That $b\le-2$, so that $-b/2$ is at least the bound
That $b=-6$, so that $-b/2$ lies to the right of 1
Only that $b\ge-2$; its exact value remains unknown
